articles.title: Expanding Google Antigravity for enterprise customers
articles.summary: Google expands its Antigravity service to cater to enterprise customers, offering easier access and security controls.
articles.detail: The expanded service provides features such as pooled usage, license management, and security controls, making it more appealing to large-scale businesses.

articles.title: 10 questions every startup should answer before moving to production with their AI prototype
articles.summary: Google provides guidance for startups looking to move their AI prototypes into production, highlighting common challenges and solutions.
articles.detail: The article covers key areas such as API key management, cost optimization, and infrastructure scaling, offering practical advice for early-stage businesses.

articles.title: Google is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud-Native Application Platforms
articles.summary: Gartner recognizes Google as a leader in its Magic Quadrant report, citing its commitment to providing an accessible and developer-centric platform.
articles.detail: The recognition highlights Google's strengths in supporting modern workloads and rapid prototyping, further solidifying its position in the cloud market.

articles.title: How AlloyDB ScaNN scales vector search to 10 billion vectors
articles.summary: AlloyDB introduces its ScaNN technology, enabling scalable vector search capabilities for large-scale enterprise applications.
articles.detail: The innovation allows for efficient handling of massive datasets, making it suitable for demanding use cases such as AI and machine learning workloads.

articles.title: Announcing quantum-safe key import in Cloud KMS
articles.summary: Google introduces quantum-safe key import capabilities in its Cloud Key Management Service, enhancing security for cloud workloads.
articles.detail: The feature enables secure transfer of encryption keys across networks, mitigating potential risks associated with quantum computing advancements.

articles.title: How to modernize Apache Hive using Google Cloud's Lakehouse runtime catalog
articles.summary: Google provides guidance on modernizing Apache Hive using its Lakehouse runtime catalog, enabling more efficient big data analytics.
articles.detail: The approach allows for streamlined metadata management and improved performance, making it suitable for large-scale enterprise data architectures.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Copilot introduces direct access to agents
articles.summary: Azure Copilot now offers direct access to agents, enabling faster development and deployment of AI applications.
articles.detail: The feature streamlines the development process, allowing customers to select the right agent for their needs and geography, further enhancing the overall user experience.

articles.title: Marvell shares jump 9.8% on Google chip design deal
articles.summary: Marvell Technology's stock surges following the announcement of a custom AI chip design deal with Google.
articles.detail: The partnership marks a significant step forward for Marvell in the AI silicon market, further solidifying its position as a major player.

articles.title: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Expands Google AI Partnership: What Investors Need to Know
articles.summary: Marvell Technology expands its partnership with Google, solidifying its position in the AI custom silicon market.
articles.detail: The deal highlights Marvell's strengths in developing AI-accelerated chips, further enhancing its reputation as a major player in the industry.

articles.title: Google pits Marvell against Broadcom as it chases AI crown
articles.summary: Google's custom AI chip deal with Marvell Technology marks a significant shift in the AI silicon market, pitting Marvell against Broadcom.
articles.detail: The move highlights Google's aggressive pursuit of AI dominance, further solidifying its position as a major player in the industry.

articles.title: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL Formatter in MSSQL extension
articles.summary: Azure introduces a public preview of its SQL Formatter feature, enabling more efficient and readable code development.
articles.detail: The feature provides customizable formatting options, further enhancing the overall user experience for developers working with Azure's MSSQL extension.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL Database provisioning in MSSQL extension
articles.summary: Azure announces the general availability of its Azure SQL Database provisioning feature, enabling more streamlined database creation and management.
articles.detail: The feature provides ready-to-use ARM, Bicep, and Terraform templates, further enhancing the overall user experience for developers working with Azure's MSSQL extension.

articles.title: Miercom validates Cisco 8000 Series Secure Routers for direct internet access
articles.summary: Cisco's 8000 Series Secure Routers receive validation from Miercom, highlighting their performance and security capabilities.
articles.detail: The routers are designed to provide high-performance direct internet access with integrated security features, making them suitable for demanding enterprise use cases.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Summarized advertised gateway prefixes for route advertisement
articles.summary: Azure introduces summarized advertised gateway prefixes for route advertisement, enabling more efficient network configuration and management.
articles.detail: The feature provides a more streamlined approach to specifying aggregated prefixes for Azure gateways, further enhancing the overall user experience for network administrators.

articles.title: Cisco Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Forrester Wave: Data Center Network Solutions
articles.summary: Forrester recognizes Cisco as a leader in its Wave report, highlighting its cohesive approach to data center network solutions.
articles.detail: The recognition validates Cisco's Nexus One strategy, which unifies networking, security, and observability from silicon to workload.
